Hi Ben / Alice,

Thanks again for taking the demo yesterday — appreciate the quick feedback. During the afternoon POC run your team hit a few truncated streaming responses and one session that returned a 503 mid-stream.

High level ask: can you share the session trace and any request IDs you still have? If you can attach the session-trace.json from your infra that would help us map tokens to server events.

For context, here's what I saw on our side: a couple of sessions where the stream stopped after ~18s, and one where the connection re-established but the client never received a final delimiter. We're preparing a short internal triage and I'd like to loop in our runtime team for a quick look — hoping for a mitigation before your exec demo on Friday.

Also: two feature asks you mentioned — auto-retry on interrupted streams (client-visible retry semantics), and a lightweight keepalive/heartbeat on long streaming sessions. If those are prioritized, please call them out and we'll include in the triage request.

Attached: proposal-v2.pdf (demo plan + timeline).

Next step: if you can send the trace + any request IDs, I'll forward to runtime and ops and start a short RCA thread.

Best,
Jordan

Thanks for the context, Jordan — and thanks Ben for the trace. I dug through the session IDs and correlated them with our edge/gateway logs. Quick findings and plan below.

Findings (fast scan):
- The two truncated sessions show a proxy side FIN/close at ~18s with no matching 5xx in the runtime (no kernel OOMs, no model error). Edge logs show a short TCP reset between our gateway and the customer's client IP for both sessions.
- The reported 503 aligns with a spike in concurrent long streams on the customer's demo environment; gateway returned 503 then client retried successfully.

Immediate mitigations we can recommend to FinMinds (today):
1) JS SDK: enable client-side "wait_for_termination" behavior — on stream EOF, validate final JSON delimiter and if missing, issue a single transparent retry for up to 5s using the same request id header (we can add a snippet for them).
2) Suggest setting lower streaming concurrency from the browser (max 2 concurrent streams per user) for the Friday demo.
3) If they control the client infra, bump keepalive interval on their reverse proxy to avoid idle TCP resets.

Product/roadmap clarity: 
- Auto-retry for interrupted streams: we have a design doc but not yet scheduled for Q3; no committed ETA. I will surface this as P1 for the streaming reliability epic and propose an initial spec for an idempotent client-visible retry by June 4.
- Stream heartbeat: engineering has a prototype. Can we scope a lightweight heartbeat (application-level ping) as an alpha for August? I'll confirm with the runtime team.

Action items / owners: 
- Marissa: create a short workaround snippet + QA the JS retry snippet (EOD today).
- Logan (runtime): confirm whether gateway can emit a clearer header when proxy-side resets occur and whether we can add request-level retriable marker in logs (helpful for traceability).
- Jordan: share the snippet with FinMinds and confirm demo configuration (concurrency).

Logan — can you ack and add a quick estimate for the gateway header change (low/med/high)? If this looks urgent, we can request a short SLA exemption for Friday demo (patch routing or temporary capacity bump).

Ben — I'll put the workaround snippet in the Drive link above and follow up by EOD. If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute runbook session today to apply the workaround.

—Marissa
